tei:div.tei:p: thog mar dge ba'i khrid yig sor bsam dbu ma'i rol mtsho'o/ /

na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi thog mar dge ba'i khrid yig sor bsam dbu ma'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros kun nyer zhi'i chu gter che las 'ongs/ /dus sogs mtshan ma'i 'dab stong lhag ger gsal/ /bde chen sbrang rtsi'i ge sar snying po can/ /sor bsam chu skyes sbyin mdzad bla mar 'dud/ khyab byed rgyal ba gnyis kyi ngo bo nyid/ /stong nyid byang chub dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor che/ /bsnyen pa'i yan lag thog mar dge ba'i khrid/ /sku yi rdo rje sgrub byed 'dir bshad bya| |de ltar sngon 'gro dad pa'i rol mtshos lus sems kyi rnyog ma bsal te shin tu las su rung bar gyur pa na/ dngos gzhi la 'jug par bya la/ de yang gnas gang du gang zag gang gis/ tshul ji ltar/ lam gang nyams su blang ba dang bzhi las/ dang po gnas ni/ spyir chos nyams su len pa la mthun par gyur ba'i yul na gnas pa dang*/ skyes bu dam pa la rten pa dang*/ smon lam legs par btab pa dang*/ sngon bsod nams bsags pas te/ rkyen 'khor lo chen po bzhi tshang dgos la/ de re re yang chos lnga ldan dgos pa'i| gnyis pa ni 'dir rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid tshang ba yin zhing*/ gsum pa ni zab lam la dmigs shing tshogs bsags pa sogs dang*/ bzhi pa lam sgom pa la dga' ba sogs te gang zag gi skabs su 'chad la| 'dir/ dang po ni/ bsod snyoms btsal sla ba dang*/ chu dang gzhi bdag bzang ba dang*/ chos rgyud gcig cing dam tshig gtsang ba'i grogs yod pa dang*/ nyin par skye bo'i rgyun 'dugs dang mtshan mo klag bcor gyi sgra med pa'o/ /rgyud du'ang*/ spyir chos ldan gyi rgyal pos bskyangs pa'i sa cha/ skye rgu 'khrugs long dang rtsod pa med par bde bar gnas pa'i ljongs kyi dben pa ni spyi'i gnas yin la/ bye brag so so'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid rang rang gi thad du 'chad do/

/ gnyis pa gang zag ni/ spyir tshe 'di'i che thabs dang*/ phyi ma bde 'gro'i dpal tsam dang*/ rang nyid kho na'i thar pa la 'dun pa rnams legs par spangs te theg chen rgyu 'bras la dmigs pa'i dmigs pa dang*| tshogs gnyis ci rigs pa sngon du song ba'i nye bar rten pa dang*/ dka' thub ngan pa dor ba'i thabs mkhas dang*/ lam 'og ma mthar phyin nas gong mar 'gro ba'i nges 'byung dang*/ gus sbyor rtag sbyor gyi sbyor ba rnams bzang ba'i bzang po lnga ldan gyi smon lam grub pa/ lam sgom pa la mi spro na spangs nas gzhan du 'jug pa'i dga' ba dang*/ spyir mi khoms pa brgyad spangs shing dgos gnyen dang grogs kyi bar chad mi byed pa dal bar skye ba'i dang*/ de dang de'i tshe lus dang sems kyi nad mi 'byung ba nad med pa'i dang*/ lus kyi rtsa rlung bzang bas ting nge 'dzin ngang gi skye ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dang*/ skyes sbyor gyi shes rab che ba rnam par 'byed pa'i byed rgyu ste byed rgyu lnga bsags pa/ sngon tshogs bsags pa te de 'dra'i gang zag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' thos mang dang*// bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyo med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes pa la rten nas bshad ma thag pa'i gnas su lam sgoms na rtog pa myur du gegs med par bogs dang bcas par skye'o zhes sa rgyan rnams su legs par gsungs shing*/ 'dir rdzogs rim goms par byed pa'i gang zag gi khyad chos rgyas pa mchog mi 'gyur gyi mgor gsungs pa bzhin/ dbang thob/ dam tshig dag rgyud grol la thos bsam ci rigs pa sngon du btang*/ rab bskyed rim mthar son/ 'bring myong ba skyes/ tha ma la lha'i byin brlabs zhugs shing zhi sogs phrin las sgrub pa'i nus pa ci rigs pa thob kyang de la rtsal 'don dang phyogs 'dzin spangs nas tshe 'di la mchog gi dngos grub dngos sam/ ma mtha'ang rtog med nyams su myong ba zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa la myong ba skyed par 'dod pa/

spyir ma dag 'khrul pa'i las snang bzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa thams cad rab rib can la snang ba'i skra shad ltar 'khrul pa'i med pa gsal snang rdzun pa slu ba'i chos can du mthong zhing khyad par 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag thams cad sgyu ma'i blo brid ltar rig nas shin tu skyug bro ba'i rnam par shar ba/ sangs rgyas zhal 'di gang gi snying dang kha la gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes pa'i mtshan ldan gyi bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus rnyed nas 'bad pa thams cad de'i phyogs su byed par nus pa/ bla ma de las 'khrul med kyi gdams ngag thob pas/ myong ba bskyed tshul skyes nas bogs 'don tshugs/ gegs sel lugs shes pas gdams ngag la nang byan chud pa/ tshul khrims la ngo lkog med pa/ dad pa khams gso bar nus pa/ bar chad phra mos kyang mi tshugs pa ste/ gcig pur sdod pa'i chos bzhi/ de'i steng du gzhan don brlabs po che mi nus pa ste lnga dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blang bar bya ba'i/ de rnams gang rung ngam mtha' dag ma tshang na/ dang po mi 'jug zhugs kyang myong rtogs mi skye/ skyes kyang bogs mi thon/ thon kyang gegs kyis mthar mi phyin par byed pas na re shig sgrub pa po'i mtshan nyid tshang ba la 'bad par bya'i bab bcol du sgom la 'jug par mi bya'o/ / gsum pa tshul ni/ yid ches gsum ldan gyi tshul gyis nyams su blang dgos la de yang dang por rgyud la yid ches pa ni/ spyir theg chen| dgos rgyud sde/ yang dgos dus 'khor rtsod bcas yin pas rtsod med la nyams len bya'o/ /zhes zhe la 'chang zhing ngag du 'don pa dag gis ni bskal pa brgya'i bar du mun khang rten kyang du ba tsam gyi mtshan ma yang mi 'byung gi steng du mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung bar gdon mi za bas de lta bu'i skal ba zhan pa dag gi ni/ nam zhig rgyud la dad pa thob kyang tshe 'dir yi ge brgya pa kho na la 'bad par bya'i lam dngos la ni mos par bya ba tsam du zad do/

/des na spyir theg chen/ dgos rgyud sde/ yang dgos dus kyi 'khor lo la ni/ 'grel chen drug cu pa'i tshig dri med 'od kyis rgyas par bstan la phab nas dus 'khor gyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ kho bos chos dkon mchog gi bkra shis su bris pa/ mchog gi dang po sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa/ rigs med pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pas 'khyud pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog kha 'byed pa zhes sogs kyi don thos bsam gyis legs par shes nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di ni/ mdo sngags gzhan mtha' dag du sbas pa'i/ gzhi'i mthar thug sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po sangs rgyas rigs med pa/ /zhes pa dang*/ dbang gi mthar thug 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang gang mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i phyag rgya mchog la rjes su sbyor ba'o/ /zhes dang*/ lam gyi mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi| |dus kyi 'khor lo 'dir bshad pa/ /rnal 'byor pa yi mthar sten byed/ /ces dang*/ gang zag gi mkha' shes rab la 'khyud lhan skyes bde la gnas pa'i rang sems 'di ni thar pa ster/ /zhes dang*/ 'bras bu'i mthar thug sdug bsngal gsum gyis sdug bsngal zhi/ /gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob kyi mtshan nyid can bden don bcu gnyis pa dang de nyid bcu drug pa mthar phyin pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i ma ning gi go 'phangs rnams bla ma brgyud pa'i zhal shes la mi ltos par ma sbas ma sgribs pa nyid du ston pas gzhan las lhag par nges shes skyes pa'o// bla ma la/ yid ches pa ni/ rgyud don de nyid rang gis nges shing myong nas gzhan la ston/ dam tshig dang ldan pa la sogs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyis brgyan/ nga rgyal dang ldan pa la sogs pa'i skyon bcu gnyis dang bral ba rnams tshang la rdzogs pa'am/

dus kyi dbang gis mtha' dag ma tshang yang phal cher rdzogs par mngon sum mthong zhing*/ sngar bshad pa'i lung rigs kyi rdo rje 'chang gi zhal skyin du legs par nges pa'o| |rang la yid ches pa ni/ de lta bu'i bla ma dang chos dang 'jal/ yid ches brnyed/ lam la snying por byed 'dod skyes/ sgrub pa po'i mtshan nyid phal cher tshang bar mthong nas spro ba khyad par can skyes pa'o/ /bzhi pa| lam gang nyams su blang pa la/ thog mar dge ba sku rdo rje bsnyen pa'i yan lag sor bsam/ bar du dge ba gsung rdo rje nyer sgrub kyi yan lag srog 'dzin/ tha mar dge ba thugs dang ye shes rdo rje sgrub pa sgrub chen gyi yan lag dran ting ngo*/ /de re re'ang*/ sngon 'gro ltos med drug ldan| dngos gzhi rnam bzhag drug ldan/ rjes spyod bsrung sdom drug ldan| dang po ni/ sgrub pa khyad par can byed pa'i tshe/ rang gi lus dang ngag dang yid dang*/ phung po dang*/ dbang po dang*/ 'dzag bde'i longs spyod de longs spyod drug po mtha' dag gam gang rung la ltos shing don du gnyer na mi 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs kyang gnad du mi 'gro bas de drug la ltos pa med par dgos la/ de yang sgo gsum gyi longs spyod ni/ las mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan lta zhogadage ba lus kyi phyag dang bskor ba/ ngag gis stod tshig dang bzlas brjod/ yid kyi dad pa dang snying rje sogs kyang thun mtshams dang khams gso ba'i skabs cung zad ma gtogs par sngon du grub pa'i tshul gyis ltos med lings skyur du 'jog pa gsum dang*/ phung dbang ni/ drang don bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga bsten dgos pas de dag kyang sbyang rtogs sbar ba bdud rtsir bya ba rnams byas nas gang 'grub brten par bya la/ nges don rim pa bzhin rdzas dang lus la sred pa spong ba ste/ bza' btung gos gsum lus 'tsho zhing bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gyur tsam gyis mi chog par/ bzang po dang mang po ma brnyed pa 'tshol ba dang*/

rnyed pa bsog par 'dod pa'i blo sna rtsa ba nas spong ba dang*/ lus kyi dbang po lnga'i yul yid 'ong la/ don gnyer dang*/ yid mi 'ong la mi 'dod pa dang*/ bar ma la rmongs pa skyes na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba sred pa 'dren pas yid 'ong la dga' tshor dang don gnyer mi byed pa'o/ khyad par khams 'dzag pa'i bde ba ni/ 'phos pa las kyi chags bral 'gyur/ /chags bral las ni sdug bsngal 'byung*| |zhes sogs kyi 'khor ba'i rtsa ba/ 'gyur med bde chen gyi gegs gyi gtso bo rang yin pas rnam pa kun tu spong ba ste de ltar ltos med drug ldan du bya la/ smon lam du bzhi ldan bshad pa ni/ phung dbang la ltos pa gnyis lus la ltos pa'i nang du bsdus pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ kun ma drug drug shes bya ste/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ rgya bod mang pos yan lag drug po re re yang rnam gzhag drug drug gis nges par mdzad pa ni/ rgyud 'grel na bzhugs pa'i don thob yin pas shin tu legs so/ /des na/ sor bsdud la yang drug ste/ mtshan don/ dus mtshams/ yan lag tshad ma/ dag dbye/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ sgra bshad de/ saṃ skṛ ta las drangs pa ngo sprod du 'chad la| 'dir bod skad la go bde ba sbyar na bsdud pa ni/ bung bas sbrang rtsi bsdud pa ltar tha mal pa'i dbang pos yul bsdud pa ma dag pa'i bzung 'dzin yin la/ de spong ba ni sor bsdud de/ so so ces pa don du ma la 'jug pa las/ da lan bsdud pa las so so mi bsdud pa yin pas so/ / gnyis pa ni/ thog mar sgom pa'i dus nges te/ rwa pa sna bug g.yon gyi rlung rnams kyi bdag zhi bzang dang g.yas kyi drag gzas byed pas las 'jam po thams cad la g.yon sngags so zhes 'dod kyang*/ g.yon bskyed rim dang g.yas sdud rim yin zhing*/ rdzogs rim la sa chu la thim pa sogs bsdud rim dgos pas/ g.yas kyi 'pho chung thog mar sa rlung chu la bsdar nas rgyu ba'i dus ngos bzung nas de la dang po'i sgom dus bya dgos pas/

de'i tshe sgom khang du zhugs nas bsgom pa'i thog ma bya la phyis ci bde dang gang 'grub bya'o/ / gsum pa la bzhi/ mtshan nyid/ sgom tshul/ spogs chog tshe 'dir ma rdzogs kyang spro ba skyed pa'o/ / dang po ni/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi nang tshan gang zhig ma dag bzung 'dzin gyi 'brel pa bcad nas stong gzugs ma grub pa sgrub par byed pa'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ mtshan mo bug pa dang*/ nyin mo bla gab med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sgom tshul lo/ / dang po la yang nges pa drug ste/ sgom pa'i gnas kyi/ lus kyi 'dug stangs kyi/ mig gi lta stangs kyi/ dbang po'i byed bcings kyi/ sems kyi 'jog tshul gyi/ myong rtogs skye tshul gyi nges pa'o/ / dang po ni/ spyir rnal 'byor gnyis byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nyi ma la lho bgrod byang bgrod/ zla ba la yar ngo mar ngo*/ zhag re la mtshan mo nyin mo/ sems can la skye ba dang mchi ba/ lam la thabs dang shes rab gnyis gnyis yod pa bzhin du sher phyin gyi mdo las nam mkha'i dang bla gab med pa la bslab par gsungs pa sems dpa' gsum gyi grangs so/ /de gnyis kyang 'dug pa'i gnas shin tu mi mthun pa'i dang po la/ mun khang rab 'bring mtha' gsum ste/ las dang po pas rab la 'bad dgos la/ de yang 'byor ldan yin na/ khang pa thog gsum rim gyi bar khang du byas na/ 'og gi sa rlan dang*/ steng gi char thigs dang*/ sgo 'byed gcod mi dgos pas bzang*/ ma 'byor na khang pa'am sa phug sogs kyang rung te/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi skyon rnams mi 'byung ba/ sa dug la sogs pa 'gro ba'i rlung seng yod la snang ba rta rnga tsam yang mi 'byung*| gsal dkar phyi rub la nang yangs pa sgom dus dgag sla zhing khams seng dus rlung phar thal tshur thal du 'gro sa yod pa gzhan rnams zhal zhal gyis legs par brtar zhing spos kyi byugs pa lus la byams shing khams bde ba sgrub par bya la/ mun khang 'bring po gos kyi mgo legs par phur ba dang*/

tha ma'i mig legs par btsums pa'ang yin te| 'di gnyis ni phyis legs par rtsal 'byongs nas rim gy-is so// gnyis pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun las/ mig sna rtser dbab pa ma gtogs drug te/ rkang pa skyil dkrungs*/ lag pa mnyam bzhagabasgal tshigs drang por srang ba/ mgrin pa yid tsam rgu ba/ so dang mchu ma sbyar ba/ lce cung zad steng du dgug pa rnams kyi rim pa bzhin rtsa srongs pa dang rlung gnas pa dang*/ sems snyoms pa dang*/ rnam rtog mi 'phro ba dang*/ rlung mi thums pa dang*/ kha mi skam pa'i dgos pa yod cing*/ thun mong du mnyam bzhag skye sla zhing gegs chung pa'i dgos pa yod de/ skyil dkrungs dang sgal tshigs bsrang pa la bsgrims pas bying ba sel zhing gzhan rnams kyis 'phro rgod sel bas ma sgoms kyang sems gnas ngang gis 'byung ba'i phyir/ rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod lam mthong ba'i spre'us gcer bu pa la de ltar bslabs pas rang byang chub thob par 'dul ba lung las gsungs so/ / gsum pa ni/ nam mkhar lta ba gsungs pa tsam la rten nas/ shin tu mtho bar byed pa dang*/ kha cig smin mtshams dang*/ kha cig mig gi thad so nyid du byed pa yod kyang*/ dang po gegs che/ phyi ma gnyis/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i lta stangs yin pas srog 'dzin mig lta stangs su gsungs kyi/ 'dir nam mkha'am gtsug gtor ram/ khro bo'am/ rengs pa'i lta stangs bya bar gsungs pa dang 'gal bas na/ grub chen sha wa ri'i man ngag las/ smin mtshams nas yar btsal ba'i sor bcu gnyis yan/ bcu drug man gyi nam mkha' la lta bar gsungs pa bzhin bya la/ de yang ha cang gdangs pa min pa/ bkab dang ma bkab mig dag gi /zhes pa ltar yas lcibs kyis phyed bkab tsam gyi ngang nas 'byed 'dzums med par lta'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ snying po gsal ba las/ mtshan mo dbyangs med khyim du ni/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag sgrub pa pos/ /byed pa lnga la bcing pa gnyis| |bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang po'i sgo lnga nas rnam rtog yul la 'jug pa ni byed pa yin la/ de lnga'i de ma thag rkyen mig gis gzugs blta/ rna bas sgra nyan pa sogs bya'o mnyam pa'i yid byed dang*/ bdag rkyen de lnga las/ rgyu ba'i rlung gnyis bcing ba ste/ de yang lta stangs gang du byas pa'i nam mkhar yid mig rlung gsum 'jug pa gcig tu gril nas yengs med du bzhag pas 'grub bo/ /des na byed bcings lus gnad gcig par bzhed pa yang lung de dang ma 'byor zhing dgos pa khyad par can mi 'grub bo/ / lnga pa ni/ spyir zhi lhag gnyis las 'dir dang por gtso bor sgrub pa yin mod kyis/ 'on kyang chos can gyi dmigs rten gang rung la rtse gcig tu bzhag nas sgrub pa tsam ni phar phyin theg pa dang bskyed rim na yang mang du yod pas/ chos dbyings dang nam mkha'i ming can chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa la dmigs nas rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'i zhi gnas khyad par can/ yang dag don la rtse gcig sems pa yi/ /zung 'brel zhi gnas mchog la rol bar shog /zhes smras pa ltar gyi zhi gnas yin la/ bdag gnyis su 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i rtsa ba dang*/ spang bya'i gtso bo rang yin par lan mang du gsungs pas na bdag med pa'i lta ba phu thag chod pa'i rigs shes btsal nas de'i rgyun la rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'i tshe na dran pa'i nges pa la sogs pa bsam rtog thams cad rgyun bcad nas/ yul gyi mthar thug spros pa nyer zhi'i dbyings dang lta stangs byas pa'i mun khang gi nam mkha' gcig tu bsres nas de dang rang sems chu la chu bzhag bzhin du yul dang yul can gyi gnyis snang med par sgom par bya ba yin no/ /'di'i 'jog tshul/ paṇa chen bi bhū tis bod kyi bu chen bzhi la 'jog tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba bzhi gsungs pa rnams/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis bzhi kar gsan nas bsgoms shing bstan pa'i ming 'dogs la/

jo nang pa/ sems rig pa bsam med du dang*/ rtse gcig du dang*/ da lta bar 'dzin pa dang*/ blod nas rang grol du bzhag pa zhes zer/ zhwa lu pa/ mi g.yo gsum ldan| spre'u sgo gcig pa/ spun gsum bar ma dang 'grogs pa/ rnga mo rtags grol gyi 'jog tshul zhes zer/ paṇa chen ba na ratnas/ bsam med| nam mkha'/ rtsol med/ skye med/ rtsa bral gyi/ rnal 'byor lnga'i tha snyad mdzad/ chos rje bla ma dam pas phyi nang ngam/ yul dang yul can la dmigs pa gnyis gnyis bsdus nas mdzad de legs par yin no/ /de nas phyi yul la dmigs nas rtse gcig tu 'jog pa la dngos dang bogs 'don gnyis/ dang po gnyis rim bzhin nang yul can la rtse gcig tu 'jog pa la dngos dang gegs sel gnyis phyi ma gnyis yin par shes par byas nas/ nyams len dngos la/ mun khang du 'jam pa'i gdan la thog mar bde bar 'dug te/ sngon 'gror sbyangs zin pa'i chos lnga po rgyas bsdus skabs dang btun pa sngon du btang nas/ thog mar mi g.yo gsum ldan ni/ lus gnad/ byed bcings/ lta stangs rnams mtshan nyid tshang bar byas te/ lus mi g.yo ba lus gnad sogs de gsum ye ma 'chugs pa/ ngag mi g.yo ba/ rlung ro cung zad gsal te/ 'gyur ba rang so ma bcos par bzhag pa sems mi g.yo ba gnas lugs stong pa nyid nam mkha'i dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med du bsres nas/ yod med rtag chad 'khor 'das sogs gang du yang mi bsam cir yang mi 'dzin pa'i bsam med rtog med kyi mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du ci nus tshad kyi bar du bzhag pa'o/ /spre'u sgo gcig pa ni/ de'i bogs 'don te/ sems 'phros nas sdod du ma 'dod pa'am/

'phros pa mi rigs par sgom min gnyid min du song pa ste/ mdor na bying rgod byung na| grims nas rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'o/ /dper na/ khang pa gsal dkar drug yod pa'i stong pa gcig tu spre'u rgyags pa gcig bzhag na/ sgo drug ka nas phyir la lta zhing nang du cung zad kyang mi sdod la/ sgo lnga bkag nas gcig las lta sa med pa byas na/ gcig po de nyid du lta zhing 'dug tshugs pa bzhin du/ dbang po gzhan nas yul gzhan la 'pho ba rnams bkag te/ lta stangs gang du byas pa'i nam mkha' nag po la mig gis btad nas blta zhing yid kyang de las gzhan du 'gro bar cung zad kyang mi ster ba shin tu grims par bya'o/ /spun gsum bar ma dang 'grogs pa ni/ mi spun gsum gyi che chung gnyis ngo mi shes par bya ste bar ma kho na dang rtag tu 'grogs pa bzhin du 'das pa'i rjes dang ma 'ongs pa'i sngon la yid cung zad kyang ma 'phros par bya ste/ 'phro mkhan gyi shes pa nam mkha' dang gcig tu sbyar ba'i yul can gyi steng gi rig bya'am myong cha de nyid kyi steng du bkug nas rang rig gi tshul du rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'o/ /'di dmigs rten snga ma las cung zad rags pas sems bzung sla zhing snga ma'i bogs 'don du'ang 'gro'o/ /rnga mo rtags grol ni/ dper na rnga mo shin tu rgyags pa gcig shing sdaung la thag pa cung ring pa zhig gis brtags na/ ji tsam thag pas sleb sleb kyi bar la phyogs bcu thams cad du rgyug cing yang yang du 'then la/ 'jur grags nas shin tu dub pa na/ thag pa dkrol btang pa'i tshe/ pha tshad rgyug cing*/ de nas ma brtags par rig pa na/ sa gcig tu yun ring du sdod pa bzhin du/ sems kyi 'jog tshul ha cang grims pas lhod du ma ster ba'i tshe| gtad med du lhod cing bkrol ba na/ 'dzin med kyi ngang la cung zad lhod par nges pas de'i rgyun ma yengs par skyong pa ste/ 'jog tshul bzhi po de dpal sa ra ha'i do ha skor la sogs pa na shin tu gsal zhing gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa'i lung dang mdo rgyud gzhan du'ang rgyas par gsungs pa rnams ngo sprod du blta'o/

/ drug pa ni/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /nyi ma gcig ni yongs su brtag /gal te rtags ni ma byung na/ /de tshe nga yi brdzun tshig yin/ /zhes rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis gsungs pa ltar skal ldan la zhag gcig nyid la 'char zhing*/ bsag sbyang sngon du btang na zhag kha yar nas rtags rnams mi 'byung mi srid/ de yang*/ du ba smig rgyu mkha' snang dang*/ /sgron me 'bar ba zla nyi ma/ /mun can cha dang thig le che// shais rab ye shes 'od gsal ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtags bcu las mtshan mo'i rtags bzhi ni/ du ba/ smig rgyu/ mkha' snang gi ming can srin bu me khyer/ sgron me'o/ /de yang de ltar sems legs par gnas pas lta stangs dang byed bcings kyi gnad kyis/ smin mtshams na gnas pa'i dhu ti'i yas snar ched du sems la gtad kyang der rlung zhugs gnas thim gsum yod/ de yang g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rlung 'pho chung bcu'i rags pa sa rlung chu la thim pa na/ /sa'i dwangs ma stong gzugs kyi mtshan ma du ba lta bu dang*/ chu'i rags pa me la thim pa na/ chu'i dwangs ma'i mtshan ma smig rgyu lta bu dang*/ de bzhin du me rlung la thim pa na me khyer lta bu dang*/ rlung nam mkha' la thim pa na me khyer phyogs gcig tu 'gril nas/ mar me gsal 'bar rtse mo phra ba rlung gi cung zad skyod pa lta bu rnams 'byung ba ni brgyud 'dir ma sbas par bstan gyi/ sa rags pa thim pa na chu cung zad kyang ma thim bzhin du chu'i dwangs ma smig rgyu 'ong don med pas rgyud gzhan du smig rgyu thog mar gsungs pa ni bla ma la ltos pa'i phyir du sbas par sems 'grel rnams su gsungs so/ / gnyis pa la yang nges pa drug gi dang po ni/ khang pa'i g.yabs 'og gam/ ri zur lta bu phyi nas mis mi mthong tsam du phyi nas rtsig pa lta bus skyor/ gangs dang chu dang*/ 'od mtsher ba'i gzugs dang sprin mi mthong*/ mig la ser bus mi gnod/ sprin med kyi nam mkha' rgya chen mthong ba'o/

/ gnyis pa ni/ nyi ma la rgyab bstan te lus gnad drug sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ snga ma ji bzhin no/ /lnga pa'ang gzhan 'dra ba la mun khang gi nam mkha' nag po dang sprin med kyi nam mkha' sngo dwangs kyi dbyings gnyis rje ba'o/ /drug pa ni/ mtshan mo'i myong rtags rdzogs pa la dang po nyid nas 'char mod kyi/ ma rdzogs pas kyang nyin mtshan phan tshun bogs 'don gyi tshul gyi sgom du rung zhing mthar phyin pa na sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ye shes rags pa rnams phyi ma phyi ma la thim pa'i rtags su/ mar me rtse mo zlum por song pa'i 'bar ba ser po dang*/ zla nyi mun gsum phyi dkyil 'khor dkar dmar nag po dang*/ cha'am glog ces pa shin tu gsal zhing 'khyug pa dang*/ thig le sngo dwangs shin tu gsal ba rnams rim pa bzhin sa sogs drug gi dwangs ma'i mtshan ma'am rtags su 'char te/ mtshan mo bzhi po gsang 'dus sogs nas gsungs shing*/ nyin mo'i drug po/ mtshan brjod kyi/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /shes rab ye shes me bo che dang*/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i mar me dang*/ ye shes sgron dang*/ gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba dang*/ /sngags mchog mnga' bdag rigs sngags rgyal/ /rnams kyis rim pa bzhin bstan to/ / gsum pa la mtshan mo dang nyin mo'i spogs mchog go /dang po ni| spyir snyan brgyud las/ so sor bsdud pa'i spogs pa ni/ byed bcings drag tu brtsam pa yin/ /zhes bya bas/ lus gnad lta stangs byed bcings rnams la skyon chags ma chags nyin par brtag la bcos nas drag tu btang pa nyid yin la/ khyad par mtshan mo'i bogs 'don ni| gting zab mtsho las sprin dmar 'thon/ /nyi zlas gzir bas mtha' nas yal/ /zhes pa zhal shes kyi rdo rje'i tshig la rten nas dngos po thams cad nam mkha'i ngang du stim nas sems kyang nam mkha' la yal du bcug pa la mi g.yo gsum ldan du bzhag go

/nyin mo khang pa bug gseng gzhan med sar lus gnad bcas pa'i mig gi thad du gyen la bug pa zlum po lhung bzed lta bu gting zab pa gcig brus bu rtsi nag por byugs te/ de la gzir nas mig sbrid sbrid du ltas te/ lta stangs bteg pas gzugs snang 'byung ba goms su bcug nas mun khang du de sgoms pas bogs 'don du 'gro bar dpal chen rga lo bzhed pa ni de bzhin du snod chus gang ba la sngar ltar bltas nas byas pas kyang ngo*// gsum pa ni de ltar 'bad kyang myong rtags ji bzhin ma skyes pa la sgyid lug par mi bya ste/ nang ler/ rnal 'byor dbang po rnal 'byor ma thob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur pa na/ /dpal ldan mi 'di 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs la rnal 'byor ldan par skye bar 'gyur/ /sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun tu 'dzin par 'gyur/ /ye shes thob na mi zad mchog gi gnas su rab 'gro gang du slar yang skye ba ldan pa min// zhes skye ba phyi ma la 'bad mi dgos par lam sgrub pa'i rten thob rgyud la skyes nas grol bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / bzhi pa/ tshad ma ni/ du sogs mthong ba'i mnyam gzhag gi tshe tha mal pa'i dbang shes 'gags nas sha'i mig gis nam mkha' la stong gzugs thog mar mthong ba dbang po'i mngon sum tshad ma'i 'dzin stangs stong nyid kyi rnam ldan du ma skyes pa dang*/ sngags kyi tshogs lam 'bring po pa'i blo yin pas stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum du 'dod pa ni/ du sogs la chos sku dang don dam bden par sgro btags pas nongs so/ / lnga pa dag dbye ni/ ye shes kyi phung khams dbang yul las dbang bya ba bcas pa drug rnam par dag pa rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa' dang phar phyin drug las khyab byed sher phyin yin/ dbye na yul du sogs bcu mthong zhing 'dzin pa'i yul can rnal 'byor yang bcu'o/

/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs su sngags thams cad kyis byin gyis brlob cing tshig gis mchog 'grub/ mthar thug dag bya drug po dag pa'i 'gog pa drug ye shes drug de dag lhar shar ba'i lha gshegs pa gshegs ma/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo ste/ sku mdog sngon po drug tshan gcig 'grub par byed do/ / gsum pa la/ drang nges kyi dam tshig lam 'phrog pa'i chom rkun gces nor gzhan la ster ba/ bar chad kyi bgegs/ rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa/ bka' rgya'i dam tshig bsrung pa'o/ / dang po ni/ nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste zhes sogs drang nges kyi dam tshig drug po spyi dang khyad par nges don gtso bor bsrung zhing*/ dga' ba bcu drug gi thig le ma nyams par bsrung ba dang*/ phyag rdor stod 'grel du bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi dam tshig brgyad bsrung bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ sgrib pa lnga dang mi dge bcu dang*/ sdig pa lnga dang*| nye ba'i sdig pa lnga dang*/ bsod pa lnga dang*/ mkhu ba lnga dang*/ chags pa lnga ste/ chom rkun lnga pa ltar gsungs pa lta bu rnams te/ mdor na sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba dang*/ rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba mtha' dag la 'dzem par bya'o/ / gsum pa ni/ rang la skyes pa'i nyams rtogs thams cad bla ma dang mched grogs khyad par can re re tsam la rtogs pa 'bul ba dang nyams bsdur ba'i ched du cung zad 'chad kyi/ dam nyams dang khyad par chos nyams chung ba la bshad du mi rung ste/ ma gcig ri ma'i myong rtogs dge bshes don pa la bshad pas dpe dkar gnod pa yin zer du byung ba lta bu phyin ci log tu ngo sprad nas lam las bzlog pa dang*/ 'bad kyang myong rtags 'phro chad pas so/ / bzhi pa ni/ nyams snang dang rmi lam sogs su sangs rgyas byang sems mthong ba sogs kyang ye shes dgug gzhug sogs kyi spang gnyen nges par bya zhing dga' gdung spang bar bya ste/ bdud kyis pha ma mkhan slob sangs rgyas sogs kyi cha byad sna tshogs bstan nas lam las bzlog pas so/

/ lnga pa ni/ bla ma'i mos gus dang 'dzag med kyi tshangs spyod dang*| zas gos kyi rnal 'byor/ rim gnyis kyi nyams len thams cad gsang zhing sbas pa'i sgo nas mngon mtshan chung la sa chod che ba bya ste/ gzhan gyi mig 'dren du 'gro ba nyung gi bar chad mang zhing gzhan la bzan pas so/ / drug pa ni/ 'khrid 'debs lugs nyams myong skyong lugs/ bogs 'don lugs gegs sel lugs la sogs pa thams cad chos rgyud gcig cing don gnyer dang dag snang che ba re re tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan la bstan na spyir gsang sngags kyi dam tshig khyad par bla ma'i bka' rgya las 'das par 'gyur bas bstan par mi bya'o/ / yan lag gnyis pa stong gzugs grub zin brtan par byed pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag la yang sngon 'gro dang 'jug snga ma ji bzhin te/ gzhan bzhi la yang dngos gzhi rnam gzhag drug kyang snga ma bzhin las/ dang po sgra don ni/ spyir dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig pa bsam gtan dang*/ khyad par sor sdud kyis mthong ba'i stong pa nyid kyi gzugs la bstan par byed pa'i tshul gyis rtse gcig tu sems par byed pas so/ / gnyis pa dus mtshams ni/ dbang mdor bstan du/ rmi lam bzhin du gzugs mthong 'gyur/ /rtags tu gzugs de bsgom par bya// zhes pa ltar sor sdud kyi stong gzugs legs par mthong ba ste/ de yang rjes mthun pa du sogs ci rigs pa yin la/ mtshan nyid pa ni/ mtshan ma bcu pa thig le gsal bar mthong ba nas 'di sgoms par bya'o/ / gsum pa yan lag la bzhi'i mtshan nyid ni/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi nang tshan gang zag gi sor sdud kyi mthong ba'i stong gzugs brtan zhing bsal ba'i phyir du rtse gcig tu byed pa yan lag lnga ldan no// lnga ni/ shes rab/ rtog pa/ dpyod pa/ dga' ba/ g.yo med bde ba'o/ /de yang gzhung lugs gzhan na/ bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag la| rtogs dpyod gnyen po'i dang*/ dga' bde phan yon gyi dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag te lnga bshad pa dang don 'dra bas/

'di'i shes rab ni gnas kyi yan lag sems rtse gcig pa'am ting nge 'dzin te| ngo bo'am khyad gzhi lta bu'o/ /rtog pa ni sems rtsing ba yul gyi ngo bo tsam 'jal ba'o/ /dpyod pa ni sems zhib pa yul gyi khyad par nges pa'o| |dga' ba ni chags zhing dga' bar tshor ba'i yid bde ba'o// bde ba ni yul dang yul can dbyer med du zhugs pas lus shin sbyangs kyis drangs pa'i lus bde g.yo med du myong ba rnams yin te/ 'grel chen las/ de bzhin du gzugs de nyid la shes rab ces bya ba ni lta ba'o/ /rtog pa ni dngos po 'dzin pa'o/ /spyod pa ni nges pa'i don no// dga' ba ni gzugs la chags pa'o/ /g.yo med bde ba ni gzugs med dang lhan cig sems gcig tu byed pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ phyag rdor bstod 'grel las de nas bsam gtan zhes bya ba ni yod pa'i dngos po thams cad stong par mthong ba rnams la shes rab ni/ dngos po rnams la sems 'jug pa'o/ /rtog pa ni sems kyi dngos pos 'dzin pa'o/ /spyod pa ni 'dzin pa'i dngos po rtogs pa'o/ /dga' ba ni dngos po thams cad la sems gnas pa'o/ /bde ba ni dngos po thams cad la g.yo ba med pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud las kyang*/ stong nyid sems 'jug shes rab te/ /zhes sogs de dag dang mthun par bshad pa'o/ / gnyis pa sgom tshul ni/ sgom khang du thun gyi mgo la sngon 'gro rnams skabs dang bstun pa byas la nges pa dang po bzhi sor sdud ji bzhin bya/ sems kyi 'jog tshul ni/ stong gzugs gang mthong de dang de 'dzin shes pa gnyis dbyer med gcig tu lta ba'i sgo nas stong gzugs dang por 'jug pa'i shes rab kyi yan lag yun ring du bskyang*/ de nas yul dang yul can 'dres pa'i sems kyi ngo bo myong rig gi cha la rtse gcig tu mi rtog par bzhag pa'i rtog pa'i yan lag la legs par bslab| de nas sems de'i cha shas snod bcud du snang ba la sogs pa'i stong gzugs kyi khyad par dpyad nas nges par byas pa'i steng du yang rtog med rtse gcig tu bzhag te dpyod pa'am yan lag sbyang*/

gsum po de re re yang zhag mang du bskyangs pas/ gzugs sems dbyer med du 'dres pa'i stong gzugs la shin tu dga' bar tshor ba'i yid bde 'byung zhing de yang ngos zin nas de ka'i steng du rtse gcig tu gnas yun gang ring bya/ de'i rkyen gyis lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad shin tu dag pa las byung ba'i lus tshor sim pa rtsol med lhun grub du skyes te g.yo ba med par gnas pa 'byung ba la yang snga ma bzhin du bya la/ phyis legs par goms nas ni rnal 'byor gcig nyid kyang yan lag lnga ka tshang bar nyams su blang zhing*/ mtshan nyid tshang ba skyes pa dang*/ stong gzugs ma rnyed pa dag gis kyang dmigs rnam de dag gi mos pa yid byed mang du bya'o| | gsum pa spog chog ni/ nyi ma gsal ba'i tshe nyi ma la rgyab bstan te rang gi grib gzugs sam/ yang na shing sdong gi rtsa bar sdad nas yal ga'i grib ma gsal po gcig la mig sbrid sbrid kyi bar du yun ring du lta zhing de la sems gtad nas gsal ba na/ mig btsums te grib gzugs gsal bar shar byung ba de nyid lta stangs stod de nam mkhar yang shar byung ba de la bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams tshang bar sgom pa lan mang du byas na/ mun khang sgoms pa'i tshe yang de nyid 'char bas| dmigs rten de la goms pa na/ ji zhig nas stong gzugs dngos kyang 'char zhing*/ bsam gtan grub pa'i gang zag gis 'di byas na sa 'og gi gter mthong bar gsungs so/ /stong gzugs grub pa'i spogs chog ni/ snyan rgyud las/ bsam gtan stong gzugs drag du sgom| |zhes gsungs pa ltar/

lus gnad byed bcings lta stangs sems kyi 'jogs tshul rnams sbyor ba drag cing ngar dang shugs bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /yang grub ma grub gnyis ka'i bogs 'don ni/ ye shes can sgrub las/ dhū ti nang du 'od gsal gzung*/ /rtogs med sems kyis de nyid shes/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs mthong*/ /gsang sngags chos la mkhas par 'gyur/ /srog rtsol sgo ru 'od gsal gzung*// 'gyu ba rlung gi de nyid shes/ /rlung lnga'i kha dog mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhi rgyas las rnams dbang du 'du/ /snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal gzung*// phra ba'i 'od la rten nas ni/ /rags pa'i 'od chen ngo sprad pas/ /rtog med 'od las srid 'das snang*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ a ba dhū tī'i mas sna dang*/ sna bug gnyis kyi 'doms sor 'od kyi gong bu'i thig le la sems rtse gcig tu gtad pa dang*/ mig sngar du snang ba'i gzugs dkar po 'od chen mig la gzan pas/ rab nag po zlum po bcos ma'am rang 'khrungs kyang rung*/ gzhan yang snang ba brtan po gcig gi steng du thog mar mig yun ring du gzir ltas byas pa'i steng du yid mig rlung gsum sgril nas bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams tshang bar bskyangs pas de gsum gyi phan yon rnams 'byung zhing bsam gtan la bogs thon par 'gyur ro/ / bzhi pa dpyod lam dang sre ba la nyin mtshan gnyis kyi/ / dang po ni bsam gtan la brtan pa ma thob pas nyin par bya ba gzhan gyi bar skabs su mun khang 'bring ngam chung ngu gang 'grub byas nas sgom/ 'gro 'dug 'chad nyan kha ton sogs cung zad thang chad pa'i skabs su dran pas zin pa tsam gyis rtogs med du 'gro la/ de'i rgyun la rtse gcig tu gang sdod sdod du bskyang*/ brtan pa yin na/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste rgyun gang brtan gyi steng du dang*/ khyad par bde sdug gi tshor ba byung ba'i tshe/ de ka'i steng du sems bzung ste bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas bstan par byas pas/

gang snang lam gyi grogs su 'gyur ro// mtshan mo ni mal bde ba la sngas mtho bar byas te/ seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi ngang nas lta stangs byas la gnyid dang bsam gtan bsres nas rtogs med kyi ngang la dran pa'i rtsis zin par bskyangs pas gnyid thug na sems stong gsal mi rtog pa dga' bde'i nyams dang bcas pa 'byung la/ srab na rtags dang nyams snang rnams kyang 'char bas gnyid dge sbyor du 'gyur ba la bslab bo/ /myong rtags ni| de ltar thabs sna tshogs kyi bsam gtan la sbyangs na/ thig le'i re kha phra mo'i nang du/ longs sku gsal la rdzogs shing brtan pa 'od zer lnga'i drwa bas bskor ba'i stong gzugs bzhin lag gi rnam pa can 'char zhing gang 'dod pa'i gzugs sgra sogs dang*/ gzhan gyi snying gi nang gi nā da sogs la sems bzung bas dag pa'i mngon shes lnga 'char bar 'gyur ro/ / bzhi pa tshad ma ni/ 'dir mngon shes 'grub pas/ 'byung lus dang bral ba'i bar do lta bu'i gzugs phra ba yang mthong ba lha'i mig du 'gyur la de yang mngon sum bzhi las dbang mngon nyid do/ / lnga pa dag dbye ni/ rnam shes kyi phung po dang*/ nam mkha'i khams dang*/ rna ba'i dbang po dang*/ yul chos dang*/ dri chu'i dbang po dang bya ba khu ba 'pho ba rnams dag bya yin zhing rgyal ba mi skyod pa'i rang bzhin bsam gtan gyi phar phyin/ dbye na yan lag lnga la yul yul can gyi dbye bas bcu'o/ / drug pa 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs su sngags bla med kyi thun mong min pa'i mngon shes lnga thob/ zhing gzhan gyi sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa dang*/ sems can gyi don la sogs pa nus/ mthar thug dag bya drug po rnam par dag pa'i spangs rtogs dang de dag lhar shar ba'i lha ljang khu drug tshan myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sor bsam gnyis ni thog mar dge ba sku rdo rje snyen pa'i yan lag te/ rdzogs rim gyi dbang bzhi'i dang po bum dbang gi lam phar phyin theg pa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa/

sngags kyi tshogs lam 'bring dang chen po/ dbu ma sbyong zhing stong gzugs sgrub byed/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa'o/ / de ltar yang*/ bum dbang lam mchog sa brgyad spangs rtogs sgrub| |tshogs lam 'bring mchog dbang mngon stong gzugs 'dzin// gzung 'dzin 'brel spyod dag pa'i mngon shes sgrub/ /bsnyen pa'i yan lag sor bsam mthar phyin shog /ces smras so/ /de ltar thog mar dge ba zab mo'i lam/ /nyung 'dus tshig gis gsal bar bshad pa 'di// bla ma'i drin las pra dzñā ratnas sbyar/ /dge bas dbu ma myur du dag gyur cig khrid ma thob cing mi dad pa la gsang*// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/thog mar dge ba'i khrid yig sor bsam dbu ma'i rol mtsho/ -PAGE 336--PAGE 337-- PAGE 310-
